x: Junior International Sarah Roberts boosted the points tally in the sprints and in the younger age group Marcella Simon had a great run in the 800 metres with Rebecca Lester picking up the 'B'event – both recorded best ever times.

Another young lady catching the eye was Marcella Simon, winning again over 800m. Herne Hill Harriers turned out a surprisingly strong team for this meeting (although they were unable to provide a single official of any description) and with the home club also at full strength we found ourselves 3rd…

In the 'B' race it was the same again as Marcella Simon again held Horsham at bay. Sabrina Scott gained good points in the sprints and then took just two jumps to mop up the 'B' long jump while Angela Abrams gained maximum points in the 'A' competition.
